definitions.anchored: Outside colors fixed to at least one old globally phase-attaining coloring; no single-edge interpolation required.
definitions.global: Global FRAME optimum is distinct from phase optimization of a fixed frame.
definitions.mu: Minimum over every U phase of the count of actual bichromatic four-edge simple paths modulo reversal and C4s modulo dihedral symmetries.
definitions.preframe: D fixed star colored1..4; U a disjoint family of paths of1..3 edges; empty U and uncovered vertices allowed; each U path alternates5/6.
definitions.support: A connected edge set containing every changed D/U membership or A-color edge, closed under every U component on BOTH endpoint frames.

first_open_global_lemma: A hypothetical positive global frame optimum with shortest negative core and secondary extrema necessarily admits a graph-realized improving expanded support, or otherwise cannot exist.
root: For every finite simple graph G with maximum degree at most3, a proper coloring E(G)->{1,...,6} exists with no bichromatic simple four-edge path or four-cycle.

statements.text: In any finite simple subcubic C19 preframe, a minimum-row negative signed cycle of length at least three has no chord, negative self row or opposite-sign parallel pair among its variables. Its actual-witness hull profile equals a weighted cyclic binary energy plus exact exterior fields and exterior-exterior touched-row costs.

A phase is optimal for a fixed preframe iff every signed cut has nonnegative satisfied-minus-violated multiplicity. Its satisfied rows connect every full-row component. Cyclic interval inequalities characterize the conditional shortest-ring phase optimum.

For every connected old-U-closed edge support, minimization over all jointly closed legal endpoint frames equals minimization over the unchanged exterior cost plus the complete boundary-profile envelope. A hypothetical global optimum of value M imposes tau(b)>=M-rho*(b) for every boundary b.

The explicitly fixed eight-vertex frame has mu1, no strictly improving pointed endpoint on any connected jointly U-closed support of at most three edges for either old attaining phase, and a four-edge support improving both boundary profile entries from1 to0. All smaller connected simple cubic graphs have an anchored support of at most three edges at every positive frame. This is a finite certificate-backed minimum order for this EXACT family, not a positive global optimum example.

On that same frame, recoloring D edge25 from3 to2 lowers unrestricted mu1 to0 on a one-edge support by moving to old nonattaining boundary phases. The old active phases both worsen. Hence anchored width4 is NOT a lower bound on unrestricted improvement support.

There are connected simple cubic prisms with two valid spanning three-edge-path preframes for which closure of one seed edge under both U component partitions has exactly4q edges for arbitrarily large q. This bounds neither improving exchanges nor the root.
The six-cycle alternating a fixed A color and singleton U edges has six minimizing phases and no forced pair XOR. Equality-only boundary-port classes do not encode all minima.
